note: PLMM orchestrates AISMM by reference, never by inclusion. edge_type is the relationship kind; compositional_role binds how the target participates to ARCH-016 (semantics not restated here). declared_min is the sole input to Minimal Version Selection and equals the matching software-product and entity min_version entries in plmm's requires. Every kind here appears in the target's exports (CI export coverage). Any upper bound PLMM cares about lives in version_range as a publish-time V-gate predicate, not a resolver input.

PLMM refers to kinds declared in APMM's exports, named in this edge's kinds field and checked by CI export coverage. Reference only: APMM stays independently owned and versioned, and only APMM defines semantics for identifiers in its namespace (ARCH-018 as a reasoning rule). declared_min equals the matching role and task min_version entries in plmm's requires.
PLMM's Business Unit is an org-unit; PLMM references the OUMM org-unit kind rather than re-defining it.
The Agent Core's portable knowledge and the Role are APMM kinds the chain references, not re-defines.
The Role Context's Org is an OUMM org-unit.

Illustrative instance edge: the deployment site's portfolio orchestrates its own AISMM product by reference, closing AISMM to PLMM at instance grain. declared_min equals the matching software-product and entity min_version entries in deploy.portfolio's requires; both kinds appear in deploy.aismm-product's exports (CI export coverage). No new edge type: this is the existing composes vocabulary.

The deployment site's portfolio references the owning org-unit; each product entry names its owning oumm.org-unit id as a Finding in the Relationships layer. Reference only: OUMM stays independently owned and is not re-defined here.

CollMM's parent unit and member seats bind to OUMM: the parent unit is an org-unit and a member seat is an established-position. CollMM references the OUMM org-unit kind rather than re-defining it. This is its only edge whose target already exists; the person-referencing edge waits for the deferred Human node.

PLMM records which team builds each product by referencing the CollMM collective kind, closing Collective to AISMM at the portfolio grain. declared_min equals the collective min_version entry appended to plmm's requires; collective appears in collmm's exports (CI export coverage). Reference only: CollMM stays independently owned and is not re-defined.
